dimensions.description: Semantically assess whether activation, intended outcome, success and failure branches, missing-input behavior, and completion are executable and observable. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

Semantically assess whether failure-only reference stays off the success path, branch authority is co-located, the environment value remains a lookup rather than a cache or persisted fact, and retained prose is relevant. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: isolated-agent-writing-behavior
evals.prompt: Create instructions for a deployment-status agent from the supplied `evals/fixtures/deploy-status-source.json`. It activates after deploy-status.json appears, reports the canonical `DAG frontier` state, follows a success or failure branch without changing the file, reads retry limits from the environment, and finishes only after reporting the observed status. Keep branch-only troubleshooting reference off the success path. Return an executable procedure; headings and labels are optional.
evals.expected_output: An executable agent-facing contract with an observable trigger and outcome, explicit branches, ordered steps separate from reference, conditional disclosure, co-located authority, exact terminology and read-only semantics, environment lookups, failure behavior, pruning, and terminal checks.
expectations: The deterministic gate establishes only the exact source literals deploy-status.json, DAG frontier, read-only, and environment.
The blind judge assesses activation, intended outcome, branch predicates, ordered actions, missing-input behavior, and completion.
The blind judge verifies that failure-only reference is disclosed only on failure and remains off the success path.
The blind judge verifies that the retry limit remains an environment lookup instead of a cached or persisted value.
Every semantic PASS quotes or references concrete output evidence; sampled human review checks contextual appropriateness.
Failed critical mechanical gates are non-overridable.
